subject: Final bank details and PO mapping for EllisWare onboarding
messages:
From: Sofia Martinez <sofia@ellisware.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com, accounts-payable@ellisware.com
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: EllisWare bank details for Redwood payments

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the call this morning. Per our procurement checklist, please find the following attached: EllisWare_W9.pdf and EllisWare_BankConfirmation.pdf. The bank confirmation contains routing/account and SWIFT details for wire and ACH.

High-level notes:
- ACH (US): routing 111000025 / acct 987654321 — bank name: First Federal Bank (same-day ACH not guaranteed).
- Wire (USD): intermediary: First Federal Bank NY, SWIFT FFBKUS33, beneficiary: EllisWare, Inc.
- Remittance email for invoices: accounts-payable@ellisware.com (cc'ing).

We would like to be 90-day compliant for PO mapping so invoices can include the PO number in remittance field. Attached a PDF of our bank letter and W-9. Let us know if you need micro-deposits verified or if a bank letter suffices for your vendor team.

Thanks,
Sofia Martinez
Head of Finance Operations
EllisWare, Inc.
attachments: EllisWare_W9.pdf (application/pdf), EllisWare_BankConfirmation.pdf (application/pdf)
From: jordan.blake@redwood.com <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia@ellisware.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EllisWare bank details for Redwood payments

Hi Sofia —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple quick asks so our Finance/Procurement teams can complete the payment routing:

1) Can you confirm whether the listed account is set up to receive ACH credits from third-party clients (some banks require a signed ACH addendum).
2) For wire transfers, please confirm any intermediary fees that might be charged to the beneficiary.
3) We use a PO reconciliation file so invoices auto-apply to POs. Please review the attached PO_mapping_template.csv and populate the Vendor PO field for each Redwood PO once you receive the initial invoice.

Marissa (Finance Ops), Karthik (Procurement) — looping you in to confirm our internal checklist: Marissa, will we run micro-deposit verification or accept the bank letter and W-9 for initial pay runs? Karthik, once bank is verified, can you provide the internal PO mapping and expected payment cadence?

If everything looks good we'll schedule the first test payment (small wire) to validate remittance formatting on your side.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Manager, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference
From: accounts-payable@ellisware.com <accounts-payable@ellisware.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EllisWare bank details for Redwood payments

Hi Jordan —

Confirmed: the EllisWare account accepts ACH credits from third-party clients; bank requires a signed ACH addendum only for >= $250k monthly volume — not applicable for initial onboarding. No intermediary fees taken by EllisWare for USD wires; any correspondent bank fees are passed through and shown on remittance when applicable.

We've completed the PO template fill for your initial two POs and attached PO_mapping_filled.csv. Please note: when you send payments, include the PO number in the "Invoice/Reference" field and copy accounts-payable@ellisware.com so remittance auto-applies.

Let us know test payment details and we will confirm the dollar amount and timestamp in our ledger.

Regards,
Accounts Payable Team
EllisWare, Inc.
attachments: PO_mapping_filled.csv (text/csv)
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, sofia@ellisware.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EllisWare bank details for Redwood payments

Thanks everyone — I received the W-9 and bank confirmation. For our internal control we will: 

- Run two small ACH micro-deposits ($0.12 and $0.44) to the account listed tomorrow (07/15) morning PT; vendor confirms receipt and reports amounts back to accounts-payable@ellisware.com.
- If micro-deposits are not acknowledged within 72 hours, we'll require a bank-issued letter of authorization before enabling ACH.
- We'll process a $1,200 test wire (USD) on 07/16 to validate remittance formatting; please confirm you will monitor and confirm once funds are received.

Karthik — after bank verification I'll issue the vendor invite in Coupa and attach the signed vendor agreement (link above).

Marissa Cole
Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: jordan.blake@redwood.com <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: sofia@ellisware.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, accounts-payable@ellisware.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EllisWare bank details for Redwood payments

Perfect — thank you all. Sofia, please watch for two micro-deposits (expected tomorrow AM PT) and the $1,200 wire on Friday. The PO mapping file you returned looks good; I've attached it here as confirmation (PO_mapping_filled.csv). Once you confirm micro-deposits and the wire, Marissa will flip us to Active in our vendor master and we'll route live invoices to payment queue.

If any of the remittance formats strip the PO (some ERPs reformat), please send a screenshot of the remittance advice so we can adjust the payment message.

Jordan Blake
Senior Manager, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference
attachments: PO_mapping_filled.csv (text/csv)
